(2,2,3-Trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-enyl)acetyl-CoA synthase
(
EC
6.2.1.38
,
2-oxo-Delta3-4,5,5-trimethylcyclopentenylacetyl-CoA synthetase
) is an
enzyme
with
systematic name
((1R)-2,2,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-enyl)acetate:CoA ligase (AMP-forming)
.
[
1
]
This enzyme
catalyses
the following
chemical reaction
[(1R)-2,2,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-enyl]acetate + ATP + CoA
⇌
{\displaystyle \rightleftharpoons }
AMP +
diphosphate
+ [(1R)-2,2,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-enyl]acetyl-CoA
This enzyme is isolated from
Pseudomonas putida
.
